subject: Post-demo security follow-up: SOC 2 artifacts & portal access for HealthSync
message_1_subject: Post-demo security follow-up: SOC 2 artifacts & portal access for HealthSync
message_1_body:
Hi Eliza,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — great discussion and very helpful context about HealthSync's data flow and PHI segmentation. Per our call, I wanted to recap the security items we agreed on and propose next steps so your procurement and security teams can move quickly: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: we can provide our latest Type II for the period Jan–Dec 2027. I attached a one‑page summary in case that helps the initial review.
2) Bridge letter: we can generate a short bridge attestation scoped to HealthSync’s ingestion pattern while the full report is finalized. I've attached a draft bridge_letter_template.pdf.
3) Trust portal access: we can provision your team in our Trust portal (read-only access) — this is the fastest way to share reports, exception evidence, and contract redlines.
4) DSQ / Vendor security questionnaire: if you have a standard vendor questionnaire, please upload to the portal or send it here and Aditya will coordinate.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: I’ll share the Type II summary and draft bridge letter (attached).
- 48–72 hours: we provision two portal accounts for your security/procurement reviewers and send invite links.
- 1 week: Aditya and Ben can help answer any detailed DSQ follow-ups.

Next steps for you: confirm the best two reviewer emails to add to the portal and whether you prefer Trust portal access or a one-off secure upload.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf (pdf), soc2-summary-onepager.pdf (pdf)
message_2_subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up: SOC 2 artifacts & portal access for HealthSync
message_2_body:
Thanks, Tessa — helpful recap. Marco (security lead) and I reviewed and this looks good. A couple quick notes: 

- We do need the full Type II report (PDF) and the bridge letter language explicitly mentioning data segregation for PHI flows.
- We'll upload our standard vendor security questionnaire (Vendors Q2 2028.xlsx) to the portal — Marco prefers we use your portal rather than email attachments.

Please provision the following two reviewer accounts:
- marco.ruiz@healthsync.com (Marco Ruiz, InfoSec Lead)
- procurement@healthsync.com (Procurement Team)

If you can send the portal invite and a DocuSign link for the bridge attestation this afternoon, that would keep us on schedule for procurement next week.

Eliza
Procurement Manager, HealthSync
